rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a practical disadvantage or negative consequence.

example.english: The biggest drawback of taking a taxi is that it’s expensive.
example.traditional: 搭的士最大嘅壞處係好貴。
example.jyutping: daap3 dik1 si2 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 waai6 cyu3 hai6 hou2 gwai3

rows.note: Use this when the drawback is an inherent flaw or shortcoming of a person or thing.

example.english: The drawback of this phone is that the battery runs out quickly.
example.traditional: 呢部手機嘅缺點係電池好快冇電。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 ge3 kyut3 dim2 hai6 din6 ci4 hou2 faai3 mou5 din6
